name: Scribd

sources.title: Scribd upload page — 'Contribute to the collection', free uploads, 140M+ audience
Scribd Help Center — how to upload: required title/description, 100MB max, public vs private visibility

requirements: Must upload a real document you own the copyright to (pdf, txt, doc, ppt, xls, docx, etc.; max 100MB) — governed by the Scribd Uploader Agreement
Title and description are required fields
Uploading is only supported on the website, not the Scribd app
Requires a Scribd account (sign-up at scribd.com/oauth/signup); the batch's /register URL returned HTTP 410 — use the upload flow instead
preparation: A genuinely useful document (deck, whitepaper, guide) — thinly-veiled ads risk rejection under the Uploader Agreement
Title and description copy optimized for discovery (Scribd indexes uploads for search)
workflow: Go to https://www.scribd.com/upload-document (or click Upload in the header)
Select the document file, fill in required Title and Description
Leave 'Make this document private' unchecked to publish publicly; adjust advanced settings
Click Done; use the provided view link / share link as the live artifact
watchFor: The batch-listed /register endpoint returned 410 — go through /upload-document which handles account creation
Public documents are indexed by search engines, but embedded links inside the doc are the SEO asset, not a profile backlink
Content must be owned/licensed — DMCA enforcement is active
Uploading your own original content can also unlock download access for the uploader (upload-benefit exchange)
countsAsLive: The uploaded document has a public scribd.com/document/<id>/<slug> page viewable without login
unknowns: Whether links inside uploaded documents are followed/indexed for link equity
Moderation review timing or rejection rate for promotional docs
